notes.title: Mini-update and future plans
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Contents[/h1]

[h2]Blue weapon, function fixed[/h2]
The specification of guns that move the position of objects has been changed.
It has been fixed so that objects cannot be brought to the other side of walls.
As a result of this fix, the shortcuts that used to work will no longer work.
Time attack ranking has been newly established as Early Access 3rd.

We will reconsider this if there are many people who think it is too difficult to play because it limits the degree of freedom.


[h2]Changes to the tutorial stage[/h2]
We modified the tutorial stage to make it a little easier to understand.
The stage has been modified to make it a little easier to understand.


[h2]Changes to the menu screen[/h2]
The menu screen has been redesigned.


[h2]Some camera shaking has been removed.[/h2]
There were stages where the camera would move slightly depending on the character's position.
This was causing some stress, so we removed the unnecessary camera work.



[h2]Future plans[/h2]
Our goal was to officially release the game in December.
However, we have received several suggestions for improvement, and in order to make solid improvements
However, as we have received several suggestions for improvements, we have decided that in order to make solid improvements, we need to make major changes to the stage content from the current stage.

Although it is difficult to release it officially at an early date, we would like to make it official by the end of 2022.

Also, we're considering changing the rules for the replacements.
We hope that people who have already completed the game will be able to enjoy it again.

The stage you can play now will be a different stage in the next update.

Thank you for reading to the end.

We hope you will continue to send us your suggestions for improvement.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1667160/discussions/

notes.title: Bug fix 10/28
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay in noticing the bug.

It has been fixed.
[list]
[*] In the title screen, pressing the "Back to Title" button when the options were displayed would cause the game to fail to progress.
[*] When using gamepad, if the game was set to windowed mode and then set to fullscreen mode, the cursor movement position would be limited to the range of the windowed mode.
[*] When using a gamepad, if you return to the game after opening the ranking screen at the end of the game, you will lose control of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the predictive line for bouncing guns would not show up in some cases.
[/list]

Thanks for the bug report!

notes.title: 9/24 Mini Update: Key Config Added
notes.notes:
Until now, we've been showing you how to change the key configuration via Steam's features.
With today's update, you can now change the key layout within the game's option settings.

It took a while to implement, but I think the good thing is that you can change the jumping process on the gamepad to your preferred settings.

In the next update, I'll make the gamepad officially supported.

In order to play the game comfortably with a gamepad, we've decided that we need to readjust the gravity and jump processing.
This may change the feel of the game a bit. We would like to make adjustments so that you will feel that we have made improvements.

Thank you for reading to the end.
We will continue to work on updates and improvements.

notes.title: 8/24 Time Attack Minor Changes
notes.notes:
There used to be a dedicated entrance for Time Attack, but now you can start Time Attack from the start of normal play.

If you go back to the title in the middle of the game and press the continue button, your time will not be listed in the time attack ranking on Steam.
This is because the ability to go back to the title and keep going back to the game is detrimental to the competitiveness of the game.

notes.title: 8/23 Update! About the pay-to-play game
notes.notes:
[h2]Updated content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed to prevent objects and characters from entering walls.
[*] Due to today's fix, some shortcut points will no longer be available, so the Time Attack ranking has been divided into before and after August 23.
[*] Changed the placement of objects in the large room just before the boss room.
[*] Fixed unstable behavior of green weapons and swap guns.
[*] Slightly reduced spike hit detection.
[/list]


[h2]Notice of pay-per-use[/h2]

After this notification, we will apply for a paid version.
We have received a lot of feedback, and the game is now much easier to play than when it was first released.
Thank you very much for your feedback and for sharing your gameplay videos with us. It was very helpful.
If it's been a while since you played the game when it was first released, we'd be happy to hear your impressions after playing it again.

Due to the change to pay-as-you-go, it looks like we will be starting over with zero reviews so far.
If you'd like to give us a review of the game, we'd appreciate it.


[h2]About the future[/h2]

We are still receiving feedback on what we need to fix, so we will continue to improve.
Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: 8/6 Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Add a tutorial at the beginning of the game.[/h1]
Added tutorials and explanations for levitation and jumping after swapping.
If you run through the game, you won't see the explanatory text because the text appears when you fail.

When you get a new gun, the description will now appear.
Currently, all players will get the description.
In the next update, the description will no longer appear for those who have cleared the game.

[h1]Chinese (Simplified) support[/h1]
Since there seemed to be a relatively large number of players from Chinese speaking countries, we have added a language setting.
If you find any mistranslations or inappropriate words, please feel free to comment on the Community Hub thread.
Support for traditional Chinese characters is under consideration.

[h1]fine tuning[/h1]
[list]
[*] Readjusted predictive lines for bouncing.
[*] Particles are now generated when levitating.
[*] Fine-tuned some camera collisions on the boss surface.
[*] Adjusted the volume of some sound effects that were too loud.
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] We are planning to set up a time attack ranking in a dedicated time attack mode.
[*] The image of the title screen will be redesigned.
[/list]

We will continue to work on the other improvements that you have pointed out.
Thank you very much for your comments and requests.
